title: Recipient-name searches do not identify the facility performing a defense subaward
source_unit: Official USAspending recipient search responses compared with retained JASSM/LRASM subaward rows and official DLA CAGE facility records
geography: United States defense-recipient and facility records

denominator.unit: USAspending recipient rows returned for the exact BAE displayed name

distinct_uei_count.unit: distinct UEIs in returned recipient rows

observations.method: Exact-name POST to the official USAspending recipient endpoint, counted by returned UEI and compared with the official DLA CAGE facility record and the retained subaward response.
observations.uncertainty: The recipient endpoint is a broad search across aggregate recipient records and parent/child levels, not an award-specific subaward join; the retained subaward rows do not expose UEI or CAGE.
observations.subgroup: Largest named BAE recipient in the bounded JASSM/LRASM subaward extract.
observations.counterinterpretation: Non-overlap can reflect identifier vintage, normalization, historical records, or different legal-entity records; it does not establish missing registration, foreign control, or absent production.

denominator.unit: USAspending recipient rows returned for the exact General Dynamics-OTS displayed name

dla_selected_facility_ueis.unit: UEIs displayed by three selected DLA CAGE facility records

overlap.unit: UEI appearing in both selected sets

observations.method: Exact-name POST to the official USAspending recipient endpoint, compared with three selected DLA CAGE facility records under General Dynamics Corp.
observations.uncertainty: The one overlapping UEI is an identifier intersection, not proof that the $80.55 million JASSM/LRASM subaward was performed at that facility; endpoint populations and dates differ.
observations.subgroup: General Dynamics-OTS comparison recipient in the bounded JASSM/LRASM extract.
observations.counterinterpretation: Multiple identifiers may represent facility, historical, parent/child, or data-normalization differences; they do not by themselves show independent capacity or fragmentation.

denominator.unit: returned subaward rows linked to one JASSM/LRASM parent award

identifier_fields_present.value: recipient_name, description, action_date, amount, subaward_number, row id

observations.method: Field inventory of the retained official USAspending subaward response, compared with the recipient and DLA identifier routes.
observations.uncertainty: The absence is specific to the retained endpoint response and should not be generalized to all USAspending views or contractor records.
observations.counterinterpretation: A separate transaction, downloadable file, award attachment, or contractor record may expose the missing identifier and close the join.

related_sources.claim: DLA CAGE records establish displayed parent and facility structures for the comparison routes.
The bounded subaward extract establishes the name/amount surface but not identifiers.
Official API contract documents recipient search fields and aggregate endpoint behavior.

boundary: This record audits identifier discoverability and ambiguity. It does not assign a subaward to a facility, establish production or delivery, estimate supplier independence, or infer geopolitical leverage.
